description_en: Queries instant virus scan tasks under the current Alibaba Cloud account by paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的即时病毒扫描任务
name: ListVirusScanTasks

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan path scopes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描的路径范围集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan performance modes. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 扫描性能模式集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: performance_modes

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus scan task IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 病毒扫描任务ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID, used to filter tasks whose effective scope includes the specified user group. You can obtain the value from:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): Lists user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的任务。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
0: Not canceled. This is the default value.
1: Canceled.
-1: No status filter. All tasks are returned
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：
0：未取消，默认值。
1：已取消。
-1：不按状态过滤，返回全部任务
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The end point for filtering by task expiration time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be greater than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 任务失效时间的筛选终点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须大于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start point for filtering by task expiration time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter must be specified together with EndTime. Specifying this parameter alone does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 任务失效时间的筛选起点，秒级Unix时间戳。必须与EndTime一同传入，单独传入不生效
parameters.name: start_time

Tasks.description_en: The list of virus scan tasks

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time is in the UTC+8 time zone
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区

CustomMatchGroup.description_en: The effective scope specified by organizational structure
CustomMatchGroup.description_zh: 按组织架构指定的生效范围

Group.description_en: The collection of organizational structure nodes

items.description_en: The DN of the organizational structure node

IdpId.description_en: The ID of the identity provider

EndTime.description_en: The time when the task expires, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp format
EndTime.description_zh: 任务失效时间，秒级Unix时间戳

HighRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
HighRiskOperation.description_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件

LowRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: Take no action
LowRiskOperation.description_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in specified user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效

MatchTargetInfos.description_en: The collection of user groups to which the task applies

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the user group

TargetName.description_en: The name of the user group

MaxCpuUsage.description_en: The maximum percentage of endpoint CPU usage allowed during scanning
MaxCpuUsage.description_zh: 扫描时占用终端CPU的百分比上限

MidRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
MidRiskOperation.description_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件

PerformanceMode.description_en:
The scan performance schema pattern. Valid values:
SecurityFirst: Security first. The default CPU usage upper limit is 50%.
Balance: Balanced. The default CPU usage upper limit is 30%.
ExperienceFirst: Experience first. The default CPU usage upper limit is 15%
PerformanceMode.description_zh:
扫描性能模式。取值：
SecurityFirst：安全优先，CPU占用上限默认为50%。
Balance：均衡，CPU占用上限默认为30%。
ExperienceFirst：体验优先，CPU占用上限默认为15%

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan path scope. Valid values:
Quick: Quick scan. Only scans critical system directories and common risk locations.
Full: Full scan.
Custom: Custom path scan
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描的路径范围。取值：
Quick：快速扫描，仅扫描系统关键目录与常见风险位置。
Full：全盘扫描。
Custom：自定义路径扫描

ScanPath.description_en: The collection of custom scan paths

ScanTargets.description_en: The collection of virus types to be handled in this scan
ScanTargets.description_zh: 本次扫描要处置的病毒类型集合
